# `gcp.monitoring.service`

A Service is a discrete, autonomous, and network-accessible unit, designed to solve an individual concern. In Cloud Monitoring, a Service acts as the root resource under which operational aspects of the service are accessible

[monitoring](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Service | monitoring |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `monitoring.googleapis.com/Service` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: custom_import (custom_import/self_link_as_name.tmpl) only parses `terraform import`'s id argument, which infrena does not use.
encoder (encoders/monitoring_service.go.tmpl) sets `custom: {}` when absent, because only CUSTOM services can be created and the block has no fields, and removes `name`, because the id is the serviceId query parameter. The generator already sends the id as serviceId. THE BOUNDED GAP: write `custom: {}` in configuration; Google's own error names it otherwise.

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/services?serviceId={{serviceId}}` |
| Read | yes | `GET {+name}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH {+name}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE {+name}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |

## Import id

Any one of these shapes is accepted, tried in order:

```
{{project}} {{name}}
{{name}}
```
